editorial: When betrayal roars louder than the law, a man finds himself locked behind a cell that feels like his own crucible. Dacoit (2026) rewrites the revenge script by layering daring heists onto a pulse-poisoned personal vendetta, weaving crime-thriller grit with psychological intrigue. Jasminder Dhaliwal delivers a chilling dual role that coaxes suspicion from each glance, yet a brief lull in the third act slightly cushions the relentless pacing. If you crave dark, character-driven thrillers where tension is a texture, this film will pull you deeper into its unsettling maze.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
